definitions: A point at which a conductor can be connected to an apparatus.
A station on the line of a public carrier, at the end of a line or at a junction.
A device, typically a keyboard and screen, used for inputting and displaying data.
A disease that is incurable and eventually leads to death.
examples: Connect the wire to the positive terminal.
The bus arrived at the terminal an hour late.
She typed the command into the terminal.
He was diagnosed with a terminal illness.
